mapper.select: SELECT a.agent_type, a.parent_run_id, a.user_id, a.actor_team_id AS team_id, CASE WHEN JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(c.request_json, 'one', '$.input.patch.firstFrameImageUrl') THEN 'first' WHEN JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(c.request_json, 'one', '$.input.patch.lastFrameImageUrl') THEN 'last' ELSE NULL END AS frame_type FROM afv_resource_revision r JOIN afv_resource_command c ON c.id = r.command_id JOIN afv_agent_run a ON a.run_id = c.agent_run_id WHERE r.resource_type = #{type} AND r.resource_id = #{id} AND r.resource_version > #{after} AND r.resource_version <= #{through} AND c.origin = 'system' AND c.request_id LIKE 'project-image:%'

SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request_json, '$.input.expectedVersion')) AS SIGNED) AS version, CAST(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request_json, '$.input.expectedParentVersion')), 'null') AS SIGNED) AS parent_version FROM afv_resource_command WHERE actor_user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND committed_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_resource_revision(command_id, resource_type, resource_id, project_id, resource_version, before_json, after_json, changed_fields, create_time) VALUES (#{row.commandId}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.resourceId}, #{row.projectId}, #{row.resourceVersion}, #{row.beforeJson}, #{row.afterJson}, #{row.changedFields}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
